visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video begins with a close-up of several transparent plastic containers stacked vertically, each filled with small, round, beige-colored cookies. A hand with fair skin reaches into the frame to adjust the stacks. The scene cuts to a brightly lit shopping mall hallway where a long line of people in casual attire (hoodies, jackets) is waiting. (2) The focus returns to the product, showing rows of green and pink cookies inside plastic boxes. A person's hands stack these boxes on a white surface; the labels on the boxes feature a cartoon bear illustration and the brand name. The background is a neutral-colored living room with a grey fabric couch and a white coffee table. (3) Detailed macro shots showcase a single green macaron. A finger presses into the center, revealing a thick, pale green cream filling. The texture of the shell appears slightly crumbly and powdered. This is followed by a similar demonstration with a pink macaron and a yellow one, highlighting the different colors and fillings. (4) The scene shifts to display large gift boxes. One box is pink and black with floral patterns and a crowned bear. A person briefly appears, holding a paper crown cutout over their head. The box is opened to show various packaged pastries and a clear jar of mini cookies. (5) The final segment shows the store counter again, with more macaron stacks and a person in a black shirt. Extensive text overlays provide details about the pop-up store's location and hours. The video ends with a close-up of a hand picking up a green macaron from a stack.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The audio track opens with a vibrant, high-tempo electronic pop BGM characterized by a steady synthetic drum beat. A male narrator begins speaking in a very energetic, upbeat Traditional Chinese dialect, introducing 'Taiwanese Macarons.' Background mall chatter is faintly audible beneath the narration. (2) As the video cuts to product close-ups, the background chatter diminishes, replaced by a cleaner studio-like environment. The narrator's speech becomes more descriptive and rapid, detailing various flavor options. Subtle high-frequency rustling of plastic packaging occurs intermittently between vocal phrases. (3) In this phase, the narrator emphasizes the texture and ingredients of the green and pink macarons. His tone remains high-arousal and cheerful. The BGM maintains a consistent intensity, providing a rhythmic backdrop to the dense speech. (4) A slight shift in vocal tone toward a more humorous and playful delivery as the 'empress' crown is mentioned. The narrator's pitch variability increases to denote excitement. The music's synthetic textures remain bright and prominent in the mix during short speech pauses. (5) The narration concludes with a fast-paced delivery of logistical information regarding the pop-up event's location and dates. The narrator maintains a professional yet friendly broadcasting clarity until a final sign-off, after which the music sustain-tails briefly before the track ends.
